title.zh: 增加阿尔拜省Tabaco市镇Ziga纪念医院床位并授权为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of Ziga Memorial Hospital in the Municipality of Tabaco, Province of Albay, and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor.
title.orig: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of Ziga Memorial Hospital in the Municipality of Tabaco, Province of Albay, and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor.

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1972/ra_6579_1972.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The bed capacity of Ziga Memorial Hospital in the Municipality of Tabaco, Province of Albay, hereby increased from twenty-five beds to fifty beds.

The sum of three hundred thousand pesos is hereby authorized to be appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, to carry out the purpose of this Act during the fiscal year nineteen hundred seventy-two. Thereafter, such sum as may be necessary for the maintenance of the said number of beds shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Enacted without executive approval, September 30, 1972.
